winter-sleep.syn: Aydın is a hotel owner and a retired actor in rural Turkey. As winter emerges he begins navigating the conflicts within the relationships with his wife, sister and existence.

young-adult.syn: A divorced writer from the Midwest returns to her hometown to reconnect with an old flame, who's now married with a family.

youve-got-mail.syn: Book superstore magnate Joe Fox and independent book shop owner Kathleen Kelly fall in love in the anonymity of the Internet—both blissfully unaware that he's trying to put her out of business.
